findings.body: This previous finding remains open. `_item_readiness` applies failed PR checks without comparing `headRefOid` with the local branch head. After a local repair commit, failures from the previous push still make both task and fix rows recommend `forge work` instead of `forge close`. Both machine views use this helper. Keep displaying the PR checks, but apply their failure to local readiness only when they describe the current head.
findings.title: Ignore previous-head failures when deriving the local next step

findings.body: This previous finding remains open. The machine board fetches only open PRs and passes an empty merged-PR set to the story lookup. Task and fix rows recognize merges only from landed state, which `src/forge/story.py:583–588` reads from the last fetched default branch. Immediately after a GitHub merge, rows can therefore retain their previous stage and merge command. The text view already obtains merged branches at `src/forge/nextstep.py:189` and applies them to fixes and tasks. Use that evidence consistently in the machine board.
findings.title: Recognize GitHub merges before the default branch is fetched

findings.body: This previous finding remains open. `live` contains only runs without an end record, so a subsequent attempt replaces the stage's start with its own timestamp. Claude and Codex commit nudges launch additional runs in the same round at `src/forge/worker.py:193–199` and `212–219`; review retries do likewise at `src/forge/review.py:473–478`. Build and Review timers consequently reset during another attempt and jump back when aggregate timing is recorded. Anchor each stage to its first recorded start in the current round while retaining the active worker's own start.
findings.title: Preserve the live stage's start across attempts in one round
